targets.query: from(bucket: "metrics") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "network_metrics" and (r._field == "send_rate_bps" or r._field == "recv_rate_bps")) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "metrics") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "network_metrics" and (r._field == "packets_sent" or r._field == "packets_recv")) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "metrics") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "network_metrics" and (r._field == "errors_in" or r._field == "errors_out")) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
